messages:
Maya G: quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem. root cause: scheduler backpressure + long autoscale cooldowns during the spike = insufficient headroom. need clear owners and short deadlines. posting proposed actions.

Sanjay: agree. prefer a short temporary quota increase to buy time while we tune scheduler. high impact, low-friction.

CapacityBot: Incident link: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-04-07-77 summary + timeline attached.

Lina: I can lead scheduler changes. proposal: scale-up cooldown 120s -> 25s, backpressure threshold 0.6 -> 0.78, enable async provisioning for preemptible workers in canary. will run perf tests in pool-g.

Eric: I'll request quota bump with cloud ops. target +15% for prod-critical pools for 10 days. filing now (REQ-2468).

Devon: compact action list (will add to tracker and create JIRA IDs):
- A1 | Owner: Eric | Task: Temp +15% GPU quota for prod-critical | Due: 2026-04-10 | Status: requested (REQ-2468)
- A2 | Owner: Lina | Task: Scheduler knobs + canary (pool-g) | Due: 2026-04-12 | Status: planned
- A3 | Owner: Maya G | Task: Headroom policy doc (target reserve by tier, burst pool policy) | Due: 2026-04-16 | Status: drafting
- A4 | Owner: Sanjay | Task: Add recurring signal for pattern detection (3 headroom breaches in 7d) + pager mapping | Due: 2026-04-14 | Status: todo
- A5 | Owner: Lina & DevOps | Task: Add scheduler metrics (backpressure histogram, kv-cache pressure) | Due: 2026-04-20 | Status: todo

Maya G: good. ground rules: 1) prefer short-lived quota fixes; 2) validate scheduler changes in canary with rollback plan; 3) track everything in the postmortem action tracker.

Sanjay: I'll add the alert and set severity to P2 for first signals, escalate to P1 on repeat breaches.

Lina: canary window request: Tue 02:30 UTC low-traffic. will include automated perf-run and warmup checks.

Eric: REQ-2468 submitted; cloud team asked for expected utilization delta, providing that now. will post update when approved.

Devon: scheduled 15-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to confirm owners and blockers. invite sent.

Maya G: any blockers on permissions or infra access? call them out here. otherwise assume owners proceed and update the tracker. :hourglass:
